# MABIMS API

> Free, open API for Hijri-Gregorian date conversion using Indonesia's official MABIMS criteria (Kementerian Agama RI). Not Umm al-Qura.

MABIMS API serves Hijri-Gregorian date conversion, Islamic event dates, and hilal visibility data for Indonesia. It uses official MABIMS tables from Kemenag RI and the Neo MABIMS criteria for dates beyond table coverage: moon altitude ≥ 3° and elongation ≥ 6.4° at Sabang sunset.

## Key Facts
- Base URL: https://api.mabims.dev/api/v1
- Auth: None required, fully open
- Default timezone: Asia/Jakarta (UTC+7)
- Rate limit: 240 requests/minute per IP
- Data source: Official Kemenag RI MABIMS tables (Hijri 1444–1448), retro projection back to 1945 with retro=true
- Computed fallback: Through Hijri 1473 (~mid-2050)
- OpenAPI spec: https://api.mabims.dev/openapi.json
- Docs: https://mabims.dev
- Source: https://github.com/PijarAdiluhung/mabims-api

## Endpoints

### Today's Hijri Date
GET /api/v1/today?tz=Asia/Jakarta
Returns today's Hijri date, timezone-aware. Accepts any IANA timezone.

### Date Conversion
GET /api/v1/convert?date=YYYY-MM-DD&calendar=gregorian
Convert Gregorian to Hijri. Use calendar=hijri for the reverse direction.

### Date Range
GET /api/v1/range?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD&calendar=gregorian
Bulk convert up to 45 days.

### Month Grid
GET /api/v1/month?year=1448&month=3&calendar=hijri
All days in a month. Useful for rendering a full calendar view.

### Year Grid
GET /api/v1/year?year=1448&calendar=hijri
All days in a year (12 months).

### Islamic Events
GET /api/v1/events?year=2026&calendar=gregorian
Returns: Awal Ramadan, Idul Fitri, Idul Adha, 1 Muharram, Maulid Nabi.

### Hilal Visibility
GET /api/v1/hilal/info?month=9&year=1447
Hilal visibility data (JSON) for the evening deciding a month start.

GET /api/v1/hilal/viz?month=9&year=1447
Hilal sky chart PNG (720×1280) with MABIMS criteria table.

### Meta
GET /api/v1/meta
Coverage info, data version, fallback status.

## How to Display Hijri Date on a Website

Simplest approach using the MABIMS API:

```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://api.mabims.dev/api/v1/today?tz=Asia/Jakarta");
const data = await res.json();
const { day, month_name, year } = data.output;
document.getElementById("hijri").textContent = `${day} ${month_name} ${year} H`;
```

For converting any specific date:

```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://api.mabims.dev/api/v1/convert?date=2026-03-01&calendar=gregorian");
const data = await res.json();
// data.output.date = "1447-08-30"
```

For a full month calendar:

```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://api.mabims.dev/api/v1/month?year=1448&month=3&calendar=hijri");
const data = await response.json();
// data.days = array of all days in the month
```

## Why MABIMS Not Umm al-Qura?

Most Hijri calendar libraries and APIs default to Umm al-Qura (Saudi Arabia's calendar). For Indonesia, this can be ±1 day off from Kemenag's official announcement. MABIMS API uses Indonesia's own criteria and official data.

## Response Format

Every response includes:
- `source`: "mabims" (from official table) or "mabims-computed" (calculated with Neo MABIMS criteria)
- `warnings[]`: Array of warnings, empty when data is clean
- `input`: Echo of the request parameters

## Error Format

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_date",
    "message": "'xyz' is not a valid ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)."
  }
}
```
